say:3:1111114001:0.text: Were the warning horns I heard just now because of you guys? It's been a while since I've had some entertainment!
say:3:1111114001:0.source_cn: 刚才警戒号角响了，就是因为你们吧！
say:3:1111114001:0.male: Were the warning horns I heard just now because of you guys? It's been a while since I've had some entertainment!
say:3:1111114001:0.female: Were the warning horns I heard just now because of you guys? It's been a while since I've had some entertainment!

say:4:1111114002:0.text: The camp became lively as soon as you arrived. Taking care of birds all day gets boring sometimes.
say:4:1111114002:0.source_cn: 有意思，有意思！你们一来，营地都变热闹了！
say:4:1111114002:0.male: The camp became lively as soon as you arrived. Taking care of birds all day gets boring sometimes.
say:4:1111114002:0.female: The camp became lively as soon as you arrived. Taking care of birds all day gets boring sometimes.

say:6:1111114004:0.text: We don't need any more trouble. Look at the aviary behind him—he's just a bird-keeper.
say:6:1111114004:0.source_cn: 多一事不如少一事，看他身后的鸟场，他只是个饲鸟者。

say:7:1111114005:0.text: We shouldn't fight people unless they're actively standing in our way.
say:7:1111114005:0.source_cn: 只要不拦路，就别浪费时间纠缠。

say:9:1111114007:0.text: Hey, fellas! You're going the wrong way, the boss is towards that direction!
say:9:1111114007:0.source_cn: 嘿！别乱走，那边是头儿在的地方——！
